melt temperature: The temperature of the polymer as it exits the nozzle and enters the mold.
injection speed: The speed at which the screw moves forward to fill the cavity.
packing pressure: The pressure applied after the cavity is nearly full to compress the melt and compensate for shrinkage.
cooling time: The amount of time the part remains in the mold after packing to solidify.
scientific molding: A data-driven approach to injection molding that focuses on the four key variables: heat, flow, pressure, and cooling.
